description: This file defines the ColorManager class, which manages assignment of color resources to activities and tasks within an Android application, providing methods to obtain colors based on activity or task identifiers.

classes.name: ColorManager
classes.description: A utility class that assigns and retrieves color resources for activities and tasks.

methods.name: getColorForActivity
methods.description: Returns the color resource assigned to a specific activity, creating a new assignment if none exists.

methods.name: getColorForTask
methods.description: Returns the color resource assigned to a specific task, creating a new assignment if none exists.

methods.name: nextTaskColor
methods.description: Selects the next color for task assignment from the predefined color array.

methods.name: nextActivityColor
methods.description: Selects the next color for activity assignment from the predefined color array.
